title: Inaccuracy in COB leading to a possible insulin overdose.
body:
Hello,

I am using NSClient to monitor my son while he is in kindergarten. I have realized the following issue which I would like to report:

**Issue:**
COB between AAPS and NSClient are inaccurate and not synced.

**When does it happen:**
Whenever I manually delete carbs in AAPS from Treatments tab. The carbs deletion does not sync in NSclient and COB is different including the deleted carbs.

**Why it can be dangerous:**
When my son is in kindergarten and I use Bolus Calculator (in NSclient) before sending SMS bolus, NSClient miscalculates bolus as it counts more carbs on board thus suggests more insulin and risking an overdose.

**Workaround:**
I have to manually check deleted carb entries in AAPS and manually remove them from NSClient Treatments' tab.

**App Versions/Builds:**
AAPS 2.8.2 Build: c07465b0c-2021-03.07-00:56 Fullrelease
NSClient 2.8.2 Build: 194549adc-2021-01-23-13:06 nsclientfullrelease

**Attachments below show the wrong bolus calculation on AAPS vs NSClient:**
![Screenshot_20210814_131553](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4725280/129444617-2f2d844b-493a-47fc-a51d-2b50e4240ce6.jpg)
![Screenshot_20210814_131459](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4725280/129444619-2643bcba-f5ef-4911-b196-19acf6e448ab.jpg)
![Screenshot_20210814_131416](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4725280/129444620-bc509ad0-167b-4413-819c-8a863d1e3796.jpg)
![Screenshot_20210814_131347](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4725280/129444621-d1d5c8d4-0572-4ba5-8afc-e1ec5417ee6a.jpg)

I replicated the issue at 14/08/21 13:20 CET 

Logs from both AAPS and NSClient are attached.

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1628940043853.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6986371/AndroidAPS_LOG_1628940043853.log.zip)
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1628940082178.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6986372/AndroidAPS_LOG_1628940082178.log.zip)

Any help would be appreciated.

Thanks, 

Chris
